draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.19, the 90th-best grade among 259 2021 draftees and 15th of 35 at WR. He went 82nd overall, close to where his grade ranked. Published comparison: Paul Richardson. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 1,099 receiving yards in 2020, 7th of 35 WRs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 6 pro, currently with the Washington Commanders. 77 career games and 16 starts over 5 completed seasons, plus 4 so far in 2026. Trending down from his peak: 2 AV in 2025 against a career-best 3 in 2024. Weak spots: drop rate 13.5% (0th percentile), yards after catch per reception 1.6 (1st percentile). Versus the typical Year-5 wide receiver who played: 227 receiving yards against a median of 255, below the norm.
